verdict.rationale: Lorikeet ships an official hosted MCP server (mcp.lorikeetcx.ai) documented in first-party docs and confirmed live via runtime probes (OAuth remote server, HTTP 405 on keyless GET consistent with streamable-HTTP MCP), enabling agents like Claude Code/Claude.ai/ChatGPT/Codex to connect and diagnose tickets, audit knowledge bases, build workflows, and test tools. missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration beyond the vendor's own docs and probes, and no evidence of broader MCP client ecosystem adoption reports.
